Alice —

Thanks for the questionnaire and the deadline, we can support this. High-level responses first, then the evidence we can provide: 

1) Definitions and measurement
- "Request success": HTTP 2xx responses from the inference ingress + model runtime completion (no internal OOM/early-truncation).
- "Endpoint health": availability of the service cluster (able to accept and respond to auth+inference requests within configured timeout).
- Measurement windows: default is rolling 24h for alerting and 30d aggregated windows for SLA reporting. We sample at request-level with per-minute aggregations retained in metrics for 90 days.

2) Alerting & escalation
- Built-in alert severities: P0 (total outage), P1 (high error rate / latency > target), P2 (degraded throughput). Typical escalation: on-call SRE -> dedicated account technical lead -> customer success for enterprise accounts.
- We can expose alert hooks (PagerDuty integration or a webhook) for your evaluation window.

3) Customer metric access
- We can provision a read-only Grafana snapshot link scoped to the account: supports 30-day view, pre-filtered to your tenancy (no cross-tenant data). Link: https://redwood.share/grafana/northbridge-readonly-2025
- If regulatory constraints prevent direct dashboard access, we can provide daily aggregated reports (uptime %, p95 latency, error-rate) and signed attestations for the evaluation period.

4) Data redaction & HIPAA considerations
- Metrics are telemetry-only (counters/timings). We never surface payloads or PII in dashboards. For customers with PHI requirements we can disable request-level traces from the dashboard and provide only aggregated metrics. We will coordinate with your security team for a short checklist.

Evidence we can attach today:
- redwood-slo-sample.pdf (30d aggregated uptime & latency export)
- a baseline instrumentation readme (inline)

Action items we propose:
- We can provide a 14-day read-only Grafana snapshot and enable a webhook to your PagerDuty test integration.
- If that works, we'll request your IT contact for IP allowlist and the person to receive the webhook.

CC'ing Evelyn (Sales Ops) and Soojin (Security) to triage the allowlist and any redaction requirements.

Regards,
